physical_conventions.clp_fractional_amounts: rejected by existing canonical money validator
physical_conventions.timestamp_type: timestamptz; server-created times default now(); occurred/received instants normalized as UTC
physical_conventions.uuid_defaults: gen_random_uuid() only for row ids; idempotency keys are caller-supplied UUIDs with no default
physical_conventions.external_id_type: text COLLATE C; exact comparison; no truncation or provider-specific UUID assumption
physical_conventions.request_hash_type: text COLLATE C, exact format sha256-v1:<64 lowercase hex>
physical_conventions.request_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over RFC 8785/JCS UTF-8 canonical request JSON; money encoded as canonical decimal strings, UUID lowercase, timestamps UTC RFC 3339
physical_conventions.zero_payment: gross_amount = 0 rejected; provider_fee = 0 allowed when explicitly verified; net_amount may be zero only when fee equals positive gross
